name: app-lavender-user-journey-node-map-slide
title: Lavender User Journey Node Map
whatItIs: A lavender slide, User Journey Map, with a plane-topped progress bar and a left-to-right tree of white pill nodes from the logo through Discover, Search and Compare to booking, payment and travel steps.
whatItMeans: Soft pill nodes make a complex flow feel light, and the tree layout shows branching clearly.
techniques: Logo as the root node in a circle
White pill nodes with soft shadows

vocabulary.definition: A diagram of the steps a user takes.
The starting item of a tree.
